metric_definitions.activated_flag: 1 if at least one log exists from Day0 through Day6; NULL if that window is immature
metric_definitions.d1_retained: 1 if a log exists exactly on registration_date + 1 day; NULL if immature
metric_definitions.d3_retained: 1 if a log exists exactly on registration_date + 3 days; NULL if immature
metric_definitions.d7_retained: 1 if a log exists exactly on registration_date + 7 days; NULL if immature
metric_definitions.first_7_active_days: distinct active dates from Day0 through Day6; NULL if immature
metric_definitions.first_7_play_count: Day0-Day6 sum of num_25 + num_50 + num_75 + num_985 + num_100; NULL if immature
metric_definitions.first_7_total_secs: Day0-Day6 sum of total_secs with negative values replaced by zero; NULL if immature
